432:t_040:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry, $$クラヴィア$$. I'll contact the resistance, and someone will come get you soon.」

432:t_040:8.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Thank you! Here, I'd like you to have this as thanks!」

432:t_041:1.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I just tried making something, and this is what I ended up with. Please use it if you'd like.」

432:t_041:4.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「It's strange... When I look at you, $$クロウ$$, my heart starts pounding for some reason...」

432:t_041:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$クラヴィア$$... We'll defeat $$バルビエル$$, the one who destroyed your mind, no matter what...)

432:t_100:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You never learn, do you?! You're coming at me again! Your vitality is ridiculous, $n!」

432:t_100:1.en:
$n
「That was weak, $$バルビエル$$. If you want to defeat me, throw all your hatred at me!」

432:t_100:3.en:
$n
「I'm the true $$リアクター$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$! I'll defeat you and prove it!」

432:t_101:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Why are you doing this!?」

432:t_101:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was my intention. But you rejected me.」

432:t_101:3.en:
$n
「That's not it! Please understand, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

432:t_101:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Understand? I understand everything, including you.」

432:t_101:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Pull yourself together, $n! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ really intends to fight us!」

432:t_101:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
(But why... When I fight him, I feel like anxiety is crushing my chest...)

432:t_102:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's a shame, $$ランド$$. To think I'd end up fighting you.」

432:t_102:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Let's stop, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! If we talk properly, we can clear up the misunderstanding!」

432:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Talk? There's no need for that.」

432:t_102:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have a duty to carry out what is right. I'm simply fulfilling it, $$ランド$$.」

432:t_103:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You keep worrying about the smallest flaw... Your $$揺れる天秤$$' $$スフィア$$ really is troublesome.」

432:t_103:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's stop, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. It seems some part of me doesn't want to fight you.」

432:t_103:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I feel the same way. But if we're putting away our swords, you must do so first.」

432:t_103:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you're insisting we're the ones in the wrong.」

432:t_103:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You know nothing... But that isn't your sin.」

432:t_103:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's why I'm here. Accept that, $$クロウ$$.」

432:t_104:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「It's a shame. To think we'd end up fighting you.」

432:t_104:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why are you doing this, $$ブルー$$?!」

432:t_104:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you don't want to fight, hurry up and withdraw!」

432:t_104:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just what the hell are you people?!」

432:t_104:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We are $$クロノ$$, those who watch over humanity's evolution...」

432:t_104:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We will simply follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

432:t_105:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The blood of the beast... Everything began here.」

432:t_105:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll sever that bloodline... here!」

432:t_106:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The mingling of waters... What it produces is nothing but harm.」

432:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Only clear water can save the world... That is my mission!」

432:t_107:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The destination of the wind... You need not know it.」

432:t_107:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Swirling winds destroy the world... So I cannot allow them to exist!」

432:t_108:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The civilization of fire... But humanity has not mastered it.」

432:t_108:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If destruction awaits it, I will save it...! For humanity's future!」

432:t_109:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$...」

432:t_109:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll dispel that sorrowful destiny...! May your fate be peaceful!」

432:t_110:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior who battles $$バアル$$... I'll end your sorrowful fate here.」

432:t_110:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is the atonement I can offer!」

432:t_111:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You who keep the world going... But that act is meaningless.」

432:t_111:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So I'll grant you rest...! People call that mercy!」

432:t_112:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Fate has begun to move...」

432:t_112:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So I will fly...! On these cursed black wings!」

432:t_112:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Higher, farther, faster than anything! Beyond all causality!!」
